Regulation: B.C. Reg. 145/2026
Made under: Clean Energy Act
Published in: No. 14 – B.C. Regs. 125 to 148, July 28, 2026
Deposit date: July 24, 2026

B.C. Reg. 145/2026, deposited July 24, 2026, under theCLEAN ENERGY ACT[section 35]. Order in Council 362/2026, approved and ordered July 24, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that section 2 of the Greenhouse Gas Reduction (Clean Energy) Regulation, B.C. Reg. 102/2012, is amended by striking out "March 31, 2026" wherever it appears and substituting "March 31, 2031". — A. DIX,Minister of Energy and Climate Solutions; J. minutes_briefs.title: BC extends clean-energy regulation deadline to March 31, 2031
minutes_briefs.summary: BC Regulation 145/2026 changes the Greenhouse Gas Reduction (Clean Energy) Regulation by replacing every mention of "March 31, 2026" with "March 31, 2031." This pushes the expiry date of the rules in section 2 of that regulation five years into the future. The change was made by Order in Council 362/2026 under the Clean Energy Act and was deposited on July 24, 2026. The regulation sets out requirements for certain clean-energy projects and utilities in BC.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Check any clean-energy project plans or contracts that relied on the old March 31, 2026 date and update your timelines to the new March 31, 2031 deadline.

key_dates.label: BC clean-energy regulation extended deadline takes effect

minutes_briefs.industries: Natural Resources, Construction & Development, Professional Services
